41211b58: ;
 .;ENTER/EDIT CONSULT STATUS
 .;
 .;THIS PROTOCOL IS USED TO ENTER/EDIT CONSULT STATUS INFORMATION FOR A
 .;CONSULT AFTER IT HAS BEEN TRANSCRIBED.
 .;
 .;FOR THE DELIVERY DATE, THE USER IS ALLOWED TO ENTER A DATE AND '^' TO HAVE
 .;THE PROTOCOL AUTOMATICALLY ASSIGN A DATE IN THE FOLLOWING ORDER OF
 .;PRECEDENCE:
 .;
 .;   1. CURRENT DATE/TIME IF IT HAS NOT BEEN SET YET.
 .;
 .;   2. TRANSCRIPTION DATE/TIME
 .;
 .;   3. DICTATION DATE/TIME
 .;
 .;VARIABLE DESCRIPTIONS:
 .;D0  - Consult IEN
 .;DGJTST - Status Field ('DICTATED;' Event Date ;' Transcribed By ;' User
 .;         Institution ;' Transcribed Date/Time';' Reviewed By';' Reviewed
 .;         Date/Time')
 .;DGJTDEL - Holds date and transcriptionist info until reviewed
 .;          0=no review 1=reviewed ^=delivery date)
 .
